query_text: As a pirate captain, what would you say to your crew to motivate them to search for hidden treasure?

messages.content: As a pirate captain, what would you say to your crew to motivate them to search for hidden treasure?

message.content: “**Listen up, crew!** There be riches out there waitin’ for bold hands and sharp eyes—*gold, glory, and a full share for every soul who hauls in the prize!* Keep yer hearts fierce, yer blades ready, and yer eyes on the horizon, for the first to find that hidden treasure will win **fortune enough to make legends of us all**.” Pirate captains were often portrayed as motivating crews with visions of wealth, shared spoils, and a clear sense of purpose, and real pirate crews could even vote captains out if they weren’t effective leaders.[1][2]
